title: Lunar Resources Insight - STAC Catalog
description: Root catalog for Lunar Prospector reduced spectrometer data products. Contains elemental abundance maps derived from the Gamma Ray Spectrometer (GRS), Alpha Particle Spectrometer (APS), and Neutron Spectrometer (NS). Source: PDS Geosciences Node.
